information: This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png) Get ready for the second edition of Bay Area Side Events Day! # The main focus of this competition is its unofficial events, which are not recognized by the WCA. For more details and unofficial events registration, see the [Unofficial Events tab](#49818-must-read-unofficial-events). **Competition Day Timing** - The competition will begin at the scheduled start time. - Lunch will end at the scheduled time. - Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. - Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called. If you like big cubes and blindfolded solving, check out [Bay Area Slowcubin' 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BayAreaSlowcubin2025), a competition in San Jose on the same weekend!
